card.name: Linking words in standard label sentences
card.fires_on: Short linking words or commas that sit just before the key term in stock label sentences, such as 'increased risk of' in NSAID warnings, 'younger subjects' in geriatric-use text, and 'Because clinical trials are conducted under widely varying conditions,'.

modes.label: Risk of in NSAID warning
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'increased risk' in the cardiovascular thrombotic events warning.
modes.example: have shown an increased risk<< of>> serious cardiovascular (CV) thrombotic

modes.label: Geriatric use wording
modes.description: Words in the elderly-use paragraph, before 'Other reported clinical experience' or before 'renal function'.
modes.example: Because elderly patients may have<< diminished>> renal function, dose adjustments may be required

modes.label: Trial caveat sentences
modes.description: The comma or sentence-opening 'The' in standard disclaimers about trial results.
modes.example: Because clinical trials are conducted under widely varying conditions<<,>> adverse reaction rates observed in the clinical trials

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words inside very familiar, repeated label sentences.
